realm_description: The beating civic center of every continent — capitals, universities, and Guild Headquarters all rise here. This is where community becomes something larger than any one person.

primary.label: Aristocrat
primary.description: Leads with inherited certainty and intuitive command.
primary.guiding_promise: I carry the weight of legacy and lead with the confidence it bestows.
primary.shadow_description: Mistakes inherited certainty for earned worth, and dismisses anyone without the pedigree to match.

secondary.label: Scout
secondary.description: Goes first into the unknown and turns fear of it into momentum.
secondary.guiding_promise: I go first — so others know the way is possible.
secondary.shadow_description: Leaps first so often they stop checking whether anyone can actually follow.

wheel.central_question: Should power come from everyone, or from the exceptional?

growth.label: Scout
growth.description: Goes first into the unknown and turns fear of it into momentum.

other_ally.label: Farmer
other_ally.description: Understands greatness is built on unglamorous, repeated care; trusts slow effort over sudden force.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will tend what grows slowly, trusting the harvest will come.
other_ally.shadow_description: Mistakes 'give it time' for permission to never intervene, even as something dies.

quarter.label: Guardian
quarter.description: Loyal and protective; loss of the people they shield is the deepest fear.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will shield what I love, even when it costs me everything.
quarter.shadow_description: Protects so completely that the people they love never learn to stand on their own.

opposite.label: Democrat
opposite.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
opposite.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
opposite.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

wheel.compatible_text: Democrat · Bureaucrat — fellow travelers of The Living Heart.
